results.title: Analysing trends of computational urban science and data ...
results.content: Trend analysis of research publications with the keywords _“Urban Science”_ and _“Sustainable Development”_ reveals a moderate but growing interest, with 38 articles highlighting this intersection and reflects an increasing recognition of the need for data-driven, interdisciplinary approaches to achieve sustainable development goals in urban settings, fostering more sustainable, resilient, and livable cities. The research funding from diverse national and international agencies, such as the Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), Horizon 2020 Framework Programme, and National Science Foundation (NSF), highlights the multidisciplinary and global interest in the emerging research areas like data science, sustainable development, smart cities, and urban analytics. The diverse funding sources for high-interest research areas with _“Urban Science”_ AND _“Sustainable Development”_ emphasise the global nature of support for data science, sustainable development, and urban analytics. The analysis of the published document in emerging areas includes research themes like _“Urban Science”_ AND _“Data Science”_ with 25 articles to consider emerging interdisciplinary work combining urban science and data science.

results.title: Data-Inclusive Open Source AI: Building a Fair and ...
results.content: > *Open source AI is not just about sharing code; it’s about fostering an ecosystem of transparency, collaboration, and responsible innovation that encompasses all aspects of AI development, including data.* The integration of ethical considerations and data privacy into open source AI practices presents both a challenge and an opportunity for OSI to lead in shaping the future of open and responsible AI development.* As we stand at the precipice of a new era in artificial intelligence, the inclusion of data in the Open Source AI Definition (OSAID) is not merely a technical consideration, but a transformative decision that will shape the future of AI development, deployment, and governance. Their collaborative efforts are essential to create a robust, ethical, and inclusive framework for open source AI that prioritises data transparency and accessibility. By taking these steps, we can create a robust framework for open source AI development that harnesses the power of data while upholding the principles of transparency, collaboration, and ethical responsibility.
